name: Humanoid -ETERNAL RING-
source:
'Humanoid'--
That is what mechanised dolls that take the form of humans are called.
Possessing artificial intelligence, the ability to function on their own, they are the pinnacle of modern technology.
As they can barely be distinguished from a real human, wealthy people have in recent years begun to possess humanoids for a variety of purposes: replacing butlers and maids, even family members and lovers.
'Rouris' awakens as such a humanoid in the Ketily mansion.
Having just been activated, he's in a state where he doesn't understand who he is or what is happening around him.
Despite that, he is told one thing.
"You are free".

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10717]Freem![/url]]
translation:
‘人形’——
这就是所谓的具有人类形态的机械人偶。
它们拥有人工智能，能够独立运作，是现代技术的巅峰之作。
由于它们与真人几乎没有区别，近年来，富人开始拥有类人生物用于各种目的：取代管家和女仆，甚至取代家庭成员和情人。
“鲁里斯”在凯蒂利宅邸中醒来，变成了这样的人形生物。
刚刚被激活后，他处于一种不明白自己是谁或周围发生了什么的状态。
尽管如此，他还是被告知一件事。
“你自由了”。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10717]Freem![/url]]
